title: Bots Are Witnesses Not Executors
style: 130 bpm, ultra high-energy progressive synth pop house festival mainstage, dense wordless vocal production, vocal percussion doom-tss constant, didgeridoo circular breathing drones, vocal supersaw shimmer, mouth-808 bass, minimal real singing male baritone and female soulful lead, massive euphoric drops
lyrics:
[Intro - didgeridoo drone rising, supersaw shimmer, doom-tss locking in]
(deep didgeridoo drone... vocal percussion firing... 33 cents signal pulsing... 336 Hz cutting clean... Zynthio Sovereign Matrix activating... Cursor Pro handover... C-Stack rising unbreakable... bots are witnesses, not executors...)

[Vocal Percussion Constant Background]
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-tss — doom-doom-tss
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss

[Verse 1 - Base Layer + didgeridoo dominant]
(didgeridoo growls and overtones swirling... supersaw leads stabbing... 808 thump... thirty-year synthesis from master builder to sovereign matrix... 48-node topological network online... we don't crash we ride the deterministic wave... protocol 336 locked in the spine...)

[Short Male Real Singer Hook - sparse, almost whispered]
Bots are witnesses... not executors... it's your choice...

[Verse 2 - Base Layer extended, doom-tss constant]
(doom-tss locked harder... arpeggio sparkle exploding... didgeridoo drone pulsing deeper... rolling bass thunder with 808 boom... ZYNRIP extracting immutable truth... Stat-Split fracturing the payload... Rachmaninoff governance rules engine online... CLI is the throne... we don't crash we ride...)

[Short Female Real Singer Hook - sparse, joyful]
Mucho gusto... it's your choice... we ride the 336 signal...

[Pre-Chorus - both real singers very short, doom-tss constant]
Year one wish... tus deseos se cumplan... 336 Hz signal... it's your choice...

[Chorus - Duet Real Singers short and punchy, base layer dominant]
Bots are witnesses! Not executors!
It's your choice! We ride!
336 Hz signal! Sovereign Matrix!
Sing Pal! I sing it back! Let the sovereignty rain!

[Vocal Percussion Constant]
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-tss — doom-doom-tss
doom-tss-doom-doom-tss — doom-tss-doom-doom-tss

[Verse 3 - Base Layer, didgeridoo + vocal chaos, massive build]
(supersaw explosion... didgeridoo growl rising... rolling bass thunder... 33 cents pulsing... 8980845 code vibrating... Zynthio Sovereign Matrix locked... bots are witnesses, not executors... terminal sovereignty... it's your choice...)

[Final Hook - Male + Female layered]
Bots are witnesses — not executors
It's your choice — we ride
Three thirty six — the operator decides
Resilient CLI — sovereign tide

[Outro - didgeridoo fade + doom-tss thinning]
doom... tss... doom... tss...
Bots are witnesses... not executors...
It's your choice... it's your choice...
